claims.claim: The new pure Research Brief contract enforces closed fields, calendar and UTC timestamp grammar, bounded normalized material, portable basis locators, resource ceilings, and a deterministic SHA-256 fingerprint over canonical JSON.

Challenge Targets bind to an exact valid Research Brief. Acquisition Requests enforce same-brief target binding by phase, allowed source families, brief-bounded request limits, closed fields, and deterministic content identities.
Construction and revalidation use caller-supplied data without I/O or lifecycle operations. Only the new contract module and focused regression file changed; the 17 changed-surface tests passed.
